tw-0kzS.title: Landscape: tropical islands, coconut palms, concrete road
tw-0kzS.summary: Two islands south-east of the main island: tropical, lots of coconut palms, lush cliffs and run-down concrete pavement. One has yellow edge lines and is a bit more built-up.

tw-3RIG.title: Route marker: township road, county character first
tw-3RIG.summary: Township road signs put a character before or above the number that stands for the county.

tw-3U8M.title: Plants: fuzzy-leaved roadside trees, red-tinged soil
tw-3U8M.summary: On an island near the Chinese coast: trees with fuzzy leaves along the road and reddish soil. It has no newer Gen 4 coverage.

tw-5awu.title: Google car: black, long antenna, red middle light
tw-5awu.summary: In older Gen 3 coverage (blurrier, softer colours): a black car with a long antenna and a red brake light in the middle. It looks like the Russian car.

differs.how: Russia has a similar black car with antenna

tw-8WC6.title: Road: white-speckled pavement on the east coast
tw-8WC6.summary: Pavement with white speckles is common along the east coast.

tw-8yzs.title: Mirror: orange hood at junctions and bends
tw-8yzs.summary: Road mirrors with orange hoods stand at junctions and bends.

tw-ADWN.title: Road lines: red edge lines for no parking
tw-ADWN.summary: Red edge lines mark no parking, especially in cities. Almost unique to this country.

tw-AJuH.title: Google car: huge blur covering the car
tw-AJuH.summary: A Gen 3 car with a very large blur over the whole car that looks like a low camera. The camera is actually at normal height, so the view is normal.

tw-AVoo.title: Google car: blue pickup truck in riverside parks
tw-AVoo.summary: A blue pickup truck seen in a few riverside parks in the northern capital.

tw-AitK.title: Plants: areca (betel nut) palms
tw-AitK.summary: Slim areca palms are common in the centre and south, mostly in the mountains. Dense patches in the north are rare.

tw-BZpM.title: Pole: red-white striped lampposts
tw-BZpM.summary: On an island near the Chinese coast, lampposts often have red and white diagonal stripes. Red-white markings also appear on the main island, especially in cities.

tw-C92E.title: Houses: white-cream coloured houses
tw-C92E.summary: On an island group in the middle of the strait: houses coloured a white-tinged cream.

tw-DIGz.title: Driving side: right
tw-DIGz.summary: Traffic drives on the right. Japan and Hong Kong drive on the left.

differs.how: Hong Kong drives on the left

tw-FdnX.title: Guardrail: yellow rail, then tall rock cliffs
tw-FdnX.summary: A mountain highway on the east side: yellow guardrail along the western half, and tall exposed rock cliffs above the eastern half.

tw-G2A6.title: Plants: areca palms in neat rows on flat land
tw-G2A6.summary: In the far south, areca palm plantations grow in neat rows on flat plains. Elsewhere they are in the mountains, and rarely on the flat western coast in the north.

tw-Gypc.title: Landscape: short-tree forests, narrow grassy road
tw-Gypc.summary: In the east: open land with small-tree forests around a narrow grassy road. Usually older Gen 2 coverage, though Gen 3 and 4 look similar.

tw-HihI.title: Pole: transformer raised on a dark green holder
tw-HihI.summary: Transformers lifted on a dark green holder, mostly in the far north.

tw-LDPc.title: Plants: leafless trees
tw-LDPc.summary: Leafless trees are mostly seen on the island group in the middle of the strait.

tw-LVli.title: Phone numbers: 10 digits, area code 02-08
tw-LVli.summary: 10 digits, with the first two as the area code, running 02 to 08 and rising towards the south. The code is often in brackets. Mobile numbers start with 09.

tw-Ldeq.title: Pole: ID stickers on lamps
tw-Ldeq.summary: Stickers with ID codes mark lamps, on lampposts and on poles with lamps attached.

tw-Ls6z.title: Plants: tea plantations on mountains
tw-Ls6z.summary: Tea plantations on mountain slopes across the island, common in the west-centre and north-west.

tw-MRFx.title: Landscape: open plains, distant low mountains
tw-MRFx.summary: In the west-centre: open plains with low mountains often far in the background.

tw-PZaA.title: Houses: boxy, white tiles, light green tin sheds
tw-PZaA.summary: Anything from cramped multi-storey blocks to single-storey houses with yards. Many are boxy with white-tiled walls, and tin sheds are often light green.

tw-QXJU.title: Guardrail: tube-like double rails in conifer mountains
tw-QXJU.summary: A high road through tall mountains covered in conifers, with tube-like double guardrails. Only covered by Gen 2 and Gen 4, and the Gen 4 is overexposed and sunny.

tw-R3Gf.title: Road lines: blue edge lines
tw-R3Gf.summary: Blue edge lines are almost only found on the island group in the middle of the strait.

tw-SMPt.title: Landscape: hilly, overcast, concrete roads
tw-SMPt.summary: An island group near the Chinese coast: hilly, overcast photos and frequent concrete roads.

tw-U317.title: Coverage: far-away small islands
tw-U317.summary: Several small islands lie far from the main island: two near the Chinese coast, one in the middle of the strait, and two to the south-east. They often surprise new players.

tw-WWc3.title: Road numbers: freeway odd = north-south
tw-WWc3.summary: Odd freeway numbers run north-south, even ones east-west. Numbers rise going east and south. Routes 1 and 3 are the longest, along the west coast.

tw-X2t0.title: Guardrail: foggy conifer road, red-legged rails
tw-X2t0.summary: A road often covered in fog, with conifers and a guardrail with red legs. Some Gen 3 photos show a sunset.

tw-X7Nc.title: Pole: thicker support under the top
tw-X7Nc.summary: In the west-centre, some poles have a thicker support below the pole top.

tw-YhkW.title: Houses: rich, multi-storey gated villas
tw-YhkW.summary: In the north-east: rich multi-storey villas in all kinds of designs, often gated.

tw-Z5mI.title: Plants: coconut palms in the south, near the coast
tw-Z5mI.summary: Coconut palms are mostly in the southern half of the island, close to the coast.

tw-ZugP.title: Pole: green square stickers on every pole
tw-ZugP.summary: In one south-western city nearly every pole has a green square sticker.

tw-ajya.title: Road lines: double yellow centre, white edges
tw-ajya.summary: Double yellow centre lines with single white edge lines. Thin roads sometimes have a single dashed yellow line.

tw-cjeB.title: Landscape: low rolling hills, messy farmland
tw-cjeB.summary: In the north-west: low rolling hills, winding roads and sparse farmland with messy, unkempt-looking plants.

tw-dA3T.title: Road: concrete drainage ditches at the side
tw-dA3T.summary: Concrete drainage ditches run along the road sides.

tw-e0bH.title: Houses: red brick or red tile apartments
tw-e0bH.summary: Red brick, sometimes red tile, apartment buildings. Most common in the north-west, also around the capital and rarely in other cities.

tw-ePib.title: Houses: small traditional-looking houses
tw-ePib.summary: Small traditional-looking houses on an island near the Chinese coast.

tw-hIN3.title: Landscape: forested mountains over most of the island
tw-hIN3.summary: The central and eastern two-thirds is forested mountain with rugged valleys. At high altitude the plants look less tropical, with temperate or conifer trees.

tw-hLAJ.title: Landscape: fish farm ponds near the coast
tw-hLAJ.summary: Fish farm ponds right by the coast in the west and south-west, mainly in the south-western counties.

tw-ibx1.title: Traffic box: large yellow stickers
tw-ibx1.summary: In the west-centre, traffic control boxes at junctions often have large yellow stickers.

tw-l3o2.title: Pole: box transformers, dark green or grey
tw-l3o2.summary: Box-shaped distribution transformers, mostly dark green or grey, often in cities.

tw-lm-473887.title: Pole: round concrete with small holes
tw-lm-473887.summary: Round concrete poles with small holes, like Cambodia.

tw-m9ZV.title: Chevron: black on yellow
tw-m9ZV.summary: Curve chevrons are black arrows on yellow.

tw-mvZD.title: Pole: blue plaque with grid code
tw-mvZD.summary: Blue plaques on poles hold letter-number codes that act as map coordinates. The useful part is the letter plus four digits: the letter gives a big rectangle, the digits give percent east and north inside it.

tw-mxtA.title: Landscape: rice plain, mountains N, W and S
tw-mxtA.summary: In the north-east, a wide open plain with mountains to the north, west and south, lots of rice paddies and houses beside the fields. Unlike the east-coast valley, there are almost no mountains to the east.

tw-p8lC.title: Pole: red-white lamppost on a trapezoid base
tw-p8lC.summary: Red and white striped lampposts on a trapezoid-shaped base are common in the big southern port city.

tw-pMsV.title: Road lines: white edge lines, no centre line
tw-pMsV.summary: Roads with white edge lines and no middle line are common. With no better clue, this is a good hint.

tw-psr4.title: Language: dense traditional Chinese characters
tw-psr4.summary: Traditional Chinese: complex characters with many strokes. Hong Kong uses it too. Japanese looks similar but mixes in simpler kana characters.

tw-rqqJ.title: Pole: black and yellow stripes to the ground
tw-rqqJ.summary: Poles almost always have black and yellow diagonal stripes that run all the way to the bottom. South Korea has similar stripes, but shorter and not to the ground.

differs.how: Korean stripes are shorter, not down to the ground

tw-s6am.title: Landscape: flat plains and farmland in the west
tw-s6am.summary: The central west is flat to gently rolling, with lots of crops and farmland.

tw-syWO.title: Plants: tight rows of Cook pines
tw-syWO.summary: On an island group in the middle of the strait, Cook pines stand in tightly packed rows beside roads. They exist on the main island too but never so close together.

tw-t3mm.title: Chevron: bent holder with black-yellow stickers
tw-t3mm.summary: Bent sign and chevron holders with two black-and-yellow striped stickers. Found only in the south and south-east.

tw-tuU2.title: Landscape: long thin valley with mountains each side
tw-tuU2.summary: On the east coast, a long, thin valley of flat gentle plains with densely forested mountains to both east and west. Most east coast coverage is here. Other valleys in the centre can look similar.

tw-ufvr.title: Train: green train car in the mountains
tw-ufvr.summary: A green train car in the south-west mountains near a forest park.

tw-vpmY.title: Bollard: black rectangle, 2 or 3 round reflectors
tw-vpmY.summary: Bollards are a black rectangle with two or three round reflectors. Similar lollipop-shaped reflectors appear on guardrails, like in Japan.

differs.how: Japan has similar lollipop reflectors on guardrails

tw-wl3v.title: Houses: old, messy, dingy apartment blocks
tw-wl3v.summary: Old messy housing and tall dingy-looking apartment blocks in northern cities.
